findings.description: The reports_archive bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration block and no ACL set, so objects are stored without a customer-controlled/default-defined SSE configuration. Any object written to the bucket relies on whatever default the platform applies and is not explicitly encrypted at rest.
The ledger_exports bucket stores ledger exports but declares no server_side_encryption_configuration, leaving stored financial data unprotected by an explicitly configured encryption-at-rest control.

The model_artifacts bucket has versioning and logging configured but no server_side_encryption_configuration, so model artifacts are written without an explicitly configured encryption-at-rest setting.
The ops_runbooks bucket contains operational runbooks (which commonly embed credentials, endpoints, and internal procedures) but has no server_side_encryption_configuration configured.

findings.issue_category: public ACL grants external write access
findings.description: audit_trail sets acl = "lcatalogopts-delivery-write", which is not a valid canned S3 ACL; the intended log-delivery-write grant gives an external log delivery group write access to the bucket holding audit records, allowing tampering with or injection into the audit trail.

Granting write/delivery access to the audit bucket means the log delivery principal can add objects; without accompanying bucket policy conditions or object lock, integrity of the audit trail cannot be guaranteed against a compromised or misdirected delivery pipeline.

force_destroy = true on reports_archive causes Terraform destroy to delete the bucket and all contained objects irreversibly, including the seeded vendor roster, removing the ability to recover or audit the retained data.

Access logging for model_artifacts targets aws_s3_bucket.audit_trail, the same bucket whose canned ACL already grants an external principal write access; combined with no SSE on the log source, log records are unprotected in transit of configuration and stored in a bucket whose access control is weakened.
